real: Retail sales unexpectedly fall in September
anon: Shoppers spend less than expected, a worrying sign
note: Census Bureau advance report released 8:30am ET 15 Oct 2014: September sales down 0.3% from August; forecasters had expected about a 0.1% fall. Stock market closed lower than the previous day in the file (1862.49 vs 1877.70).

real: A second Dallas nurse tests positive for Ebola
anon: Officials confirm a second case of a serious illness
note: CDC statement and 12:45pm ET briefing on 15 Oct 2014 (during trading hours) reported the preliminary positive test from the Texas state lab; CDC lab confirmation followed the same day.

real: Weekly jobless claims fall to a 14-year low
anon: Fewer people claim jobless benefits than in a long while
note: Labor Department release 8:30am ET 16 Oct 2014: advance initial claims 264000 for the week ending 11 Oct; lowest since 15 April 2000 (14 years and 6 months).

real: Fed's Bullard says delay the end of bond buying
anon: A central banker says stimulus may need to last longer
note: St. Louis Fed president James Bullard on Bloomberg TV shortly after 10am ET 16 Oct 2014 (during trading hours); markets reversed higher after falling. Bloomberg transcript page returned 403 to the checker so its text was not opened; the Fox Business report was opened. No official Fed page for the interview was found.

real: WHO declares Nigeria free of Ebola
anon: Health officials give one country the all-clear
note: WHO announcement in Abuja on 20 Oct 2014 after 42 days with no new cases.

real: Overnight, China says growth is at a five-year low
anon: Overnight, a huge economy's growth is weakest in years
note: China's NBS released Q3 GDP (7.3% year on year) at 10am Beijing time on 21 Oct 2014 which is the evening of 20 Oct in New York; so shown on the next trading day. CBS calls it the weakest in more than five years. Day was the biggest rise in the file but no market move is claimed in the line.

real: A gunman kills a soldier at Ottawa's war memorial
anon: A gunman kills a soldier in an attack abroad
note: Attack on 22 Oct 2014 in the morning (about 9:50am ET). Cpl Nathan Cirillo died; the gunman was killed inside Parliament. The PMO advisory only confirms the attacks in Ottawa that day; the Canadian Encyclopedia opened page gives the facts.

real: After the close, New York reports a doctor has Ebola
anon: After the close, a new case of the illness is reported
note: New York City Health Department lab reported a preliminary positive test on the evening of Thursday 23 Oct 2014 (press conference just before 10pm ET); next trading day is Friday 24 Oct. CDC confirmation followed on 24 Oct.
